title: Dreams Come True - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
DREAMS COME TRUE 30A - 30A Five Star Properties– Gulf-Front Condo Highlights

🏖️ Gulf-front condo with breathtaking, unobstructed views 🌅 Top-floor corner unit with vaulted ceilings — no upstairs neighbors in a low-density building 🏝️ Private beach access shared by only 24 units ⛱️ Seasonal beach chair service included (2 chairs + umbrella | March 1–Oct 31) 🛏️ Sleeps 4 comfortably (King bed, two double beds) 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen ☕ Keurig and drip coffee maker 🧺 In-unit washer & dryer 📺 Smart TVs with cable in living room & bedroom 🌐 High-speed Wi-Fi 🏊 Community pool (not heated) 🔥 Community grills 🚶‍♀️ Prime location- 1.3 miles to Seaside, Walk to restaurants & shopping

Relax and unwind in this cozy Seagrove condo. Boasting Gulf views and direct beach access, this two-bedroom getaway comes fully equipped with all the comforts of home. The full kitchen comes ready for home cooking with a full suite of major appliances, including a dishwasher for easy cleanup. The gulf front private balcony is perfect for sipping a morning cup of coffee or a sunset cocktail. The spacious primary bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom and beautiful gulf front views and a second door to the balcony. A second bedroom includes two double beds along with a bathroom with bathtub and shower.

WHAT'S NEARBY This property is part of the Beachside Condos, a Gulf-front complex in Seagrove Beach with a private boardwalk that leads to the beach. You'll be across the street from several shops, eateries, and recreational outfitters that rent bikes and kayaks.

THINGS TO KNOW Parking notes: 1 spot per unit. No assigned spot, can park in any spot. Golf cart rentals are allowed. You can rent a gas powered golf cart and utilize your parking space OR rent a battery powered golf cart rental across the street at Butterfly Bike and Kayak and park/charge there.

This rental is located on floor 3. No elevator onsite. Sorry, HOA does not allow pets.

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation. *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
Expectations: Potential Noise You will hear the waves and change of tide If there is a thunderstorm you will be able to hear the wind and rain as we are on the top floor. You may also hear other guests as they walk by the unit">
Limited Amenities Covid - Bring any EXTRA sleeping pillows, blankets. We have 2 pillows per bed- no extras Please bring your own paper products toiletries (shampoo, condition, body soap, etc)">
Near Lake, River, or Water Body Please supervise all guests on balcony: Do not lean over rails/stand on furniture on the balcony. We are on the 3rd floor">

Heights With No Fence We are located next to the dunes ...there is a small fence that is not to be crossed...the dunes are below the fence. You are not allowed on the dunes for any reason. Please supervise anyone in your group Do not stand on furniture on the balcony">
Check Out Tasks: Throw Away Trash Dispose of the trash in the dumpster located in the parking lot.">
Lock Up Lock master bedroom balcony door Pull Main Entry door closed, make sure it is closed and locked">

Additional Requests Please dispose of any food and beverages that are in the cabinets/refrigerator. Also please take any beach goodies that you may have home with you or dispose of them in the dumpster located in the parking area.">
